facts.fact: Emily 隐瞒私情的理由是"不想听评判"，信任与否未定。
facts.anchor: Emily hadn’t told her flatmates, not because she didn’t trust them – she was undecided on that – but because she didn’t care to hear their judgements.

facts.anchor: The girlfriend – whom he had variously referred to as Becca, Becky and Jessie – apparently now studied abroad.

facts.fact: Matty 转述欠租争吵并补刀"只有我在付钱"。
facts.anchor: ‘Er, he said you also owe Alice rent and why didn’t she pick on you? Turns out, I’m the only one who’s been paying her anything. Ha.’

facts.fact: JJ 的指控：Alice 放过 Emily 是因为"瘆人的女生暗恋"。
facts.anchor: Alice deflects, somehow, then JJ says the reason she lets you get away with it is because she has this creepy girl crush on you.’

facts.fact: 章末 Emily 心思飘回 Bradford 与车里。
facts.anchor: Her mind drifted back to Bradford, to Aiden and their corner in the pub, to what they did later in the car.
